stories.headline: Canada end England's four-year unbeaten run in women's rugby
stories.summary: Canada beat England 24–21 in a WXV Global Series match in Toronto. The defeat ended the Red Roses' four-year unbeaten run at 41 matches, the longest in rugby union history. Shoshanah Seumanutafa scored a late try to settle it.

stories.headline: Czech governing party wins none of the contested Senate seats
stories.summary: Voters in Czechia have finished voting in the second round of their Senate election. With all votes counted, the governing ANO 2011 did not win any of the 27 contested seats and lost the only seat it was defending. Mayors and Independents won nine, more than any other party.

stories.headline: Morocco's first woman prime minister takes office
stories.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri has taken office as prime minister of Morocco, her four-party coalition government formally appointed. King Mohammed VI named her on 29 September 2026, the first woman to hold the office. She had earlier been mayor of Marrakesh.

stories.headline: The nightjar trades efficient wings for agility
stories.summary: Scientists have looked at how the European nightjar's wings work. The bird gives up some efficiency in flight in return for agility, and it keeps generating thrust even as the wings rise. That technique had mainly been associated with bats and insects.
